title: Test-ref flow: the review-freeze fingerprint hashes HEAD, so a test commit of the same tree never reproduces it
outcome: The test-ref rule and its dispatch packets state an identity check that a test-ref gate can actually meet. The check is tree-id equality plus the runner's own fingerprint matching before and after its run. A cross-commit fingerprint equality is never required when the fingerprint binds HEAD.
acceptance: docs/test.md (or the test-ref section it points to) states which fingerprint names the ref and which checks bind the runner's input identity, and notes that scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs includes HEAD, so a detached test commit of the same tree has a different fingerprint.

The packet template or guidance that integration owners use for test-ref dispatch asks for tree-id equality and the runner's own before/after fingerprint equality, not equality with the reviewer's fingerprint.
